title: [task] stale threshold prose in ccp16.json / ccp16-hop.json descriptions; channel_plan.py docstring says 'eight'
description: Sweep docs/spec-coverage/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md — fixture/doc hygiene, not a MUST gap. ccp16.json vector descriptions still reference the pre-decision '>8' threshold ('Channel forced to 0 by density>8', 'density=10 forces channel 0, sf=11 (density>8)', 'density<=8 so non-zero') contradicting the density-high decision (>10) and the vectors' own outputs (density=10 → channel 1, sf=10; vector select_channel_density_high_ch0 name+description contradict its output). ccp16-hop.json description cites 'spec/02a:120 SelectChannel pseudocode' (CCP-16) instead of the CCP-12 SynchronizedHopChannel pseudocode it actually pins. Related one-liner: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py:110 docstring 'Density above eight forces control channel CH0' → ten. Outputs verified correct; prose only.
